    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-python",
        children: ["values = np.array([-", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "2.0"
        }), ", -", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0.1"
        }), ", ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",

        }), ", ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0.4"
        }), ", ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "2.0"
        }), "])\n", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-built_in",
          children: "print"
        }), "(np.maximum(", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"
        }), ", values))\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "输入从负数区域移动到正数区域时，ReLU 的行为会发生变化。多层网络正是通过很多个这样的非线性分段，表示比一条直线复杂的关系。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "softmax-的数值稳定性实验",

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {

          className: "hljs-number",

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

        children: "nan"

          children: "print"
        }), "(probabilities)\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "原来的最大类别仍然是最大类别，但指数的输入已经落在较小范围内。这个小改动是工程代码里经常出现的“数学上等价、数值上更安全”。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {

      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "probabilities.sum(axis=1)"
        }), " 的两个值都应接近 1；"]
      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {

      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

      }), " 改成不经过 ReLU，比较输出；把第三层输出从 3 改成 5，逐个同步 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "W3"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "b3"

        children: "4"
      }), "。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "前向传播到这里已经完整了，但随机参数没有理由接近正确答案。下一篇给网络加上损失函数和梯度下降，让参数开始移动。"
    })]
  });
}
function MDXContent(props = {}) {
  const {wrapper: MDXLayout} = {
    ..._provideComponents(),
    ...props.components
  };
  return MDXLayout ? _jsx(MDXLayout, {
    ...props,
    children: _jsx(_createMdxContent, {
      ...props
    })
  }) : _createMdxContent(props);
}
return {
  default: MDXContent
};

  throw new Error("Expected " + (component ? "component" : "object") + " `" + id + "` to be defined: you likely forgot to import, pass, or provide it.");
